summary.name: WaveAI
summary.one_liner: WaveAI (wave-ai.net) is an AI music company building foundational music generation models, with lyric and melody/songwriting tools called LyricStudio and MelodyStudio.
use_cases: reading about generative AI in music
summary.what_it_does: The page describes WaveAI as a company developing next-generation foundational music AI models, described as 'coming soon'. It names two products: LyricStudio, described as a lyrical AI used by artists and creators, and MelodyStudio, described as a songwriting platform using generative models for vocal melody and chord generation. The page also lists news articles about generative AI and music. It gives no details on how the tools work, their inputs or outputs, or their interfaces.
notable: MelodyStudio for vocal melody and chord generation
Foundational music AI models in development
caveats: Page says the foundational models are 'coming soon', so they may not be available yet
No pricing or access information is given on the page
Mostly marketing claims; the page gives few concrete product details
